registration.detail: Registered on init whenever Fair Events is active. Fair Audience, Fair Form, and Fair Payments Connector extend it when active.

minimal.title: Signup for the current event
minimal.description: Resolves the event date from the post it is placed on and shows its ticket types.

with-questions.title: Signup with Fair Form questions
with-questions.description: Adds an intro paragraph, a text question, a required single choice, a follow-up shown only for one answer, and a consent checkbox. Needs Fair Form for the question blocks.

explicit-event-date.title: Signup for a specific event date
explicit-event-date.description: Pins the form to one event date, for use on a page that is not linked to the event.

syntheticIds.eventDateId: ID of an event date (Fair Events → Events; table fair_event_dates). 0 or omitted means: use the event date of the current post.
